# Class: `ToolkitTransport`

Runs the toolkit process and exchanges newline-delimited JSON on a worker thread.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-inptk-client.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_client.py#L12) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QObject`.

Emits replies, process failures, and stderr diagnostics with a connection generation. Its compute slot also runs local jobs on the worker thread; these jobs must use snapshots and must not access Qt widgets.
